evidence_en: YellowMega mirror of the 'New Superkids nursery เชียงใหม่' Facebook page shows the page description 'open every day, 24 hours', accepting children from birth to 6 (and up to 15 for children with developmental delay), with owner contact 085-868-5999; a post dated 03/03/2026 carries hashtags 'open 7am to 8pm every day', 'weekend childcare' and 'nursery accepting children for overnight stays'. This is a public claim that overnight care is offered; nothing indicates recurring boarding or long-term residence. Other directories give daytime hours only (CMHY Mon-Sat 07:30-17:30; Exa Mon-Fri 07:30-17:30; older Thaiaupair list Mon-Fri 07:00-17:30, closed weekends; YellowMega table Mon-Fri 07:00-18:00, Sat-Sun 07:00-17:00).

stay_length_pattern: day care plus advertised overnight stays; frequency and duration of overnight stays unknown
identity_match_basis: Owner phone 085-868-5999 in FB description matches directory phone/Line ID 0858685999; CMHY lists นิว ซุปเปอร์คิดส์ เนอร์สเซอรรี่ at 100/33 ม.5 ต.ฟ้าฮ่าม with phone 053-246-257 and GPS 18.8189600, 99.0125410 exactly matching directory. Post refers to 'ซุปเปอร์คิดส์(รวมโชค-เชียงใหม่)', consistent with a 2011 listing placing the nursery between Theppanya Hospital road and Ruamchok market.
searches_run: New Superkids nursery เชียงใหม่ ฟ้าฮ่าม นิวซุปเปอร์คิดส์

WebFetch yellowmega.com New Superkids nursery page
notes: Under the rules, a '24 hours' claim alone does not establish residence; here there is also an explicit overnight-stay hashtag, so classified occasional_overnight_or_respite rather than unresolved. Evidence is a third-party mirror of Facebook content, not the Facebook page itself (not opened). The advertised acceptance up to age 15 for children with developmental delay is wider than the licensed range (0.2-4 yrs) – recorded as stated, no inference drawn. Directory fee includes 390/day option. Hours sources conflict; partner should confirm whether overnight care is actually provided, how often, and for how long.
